title: Accounts & Administration Assistant
description:
Blue Arrow is urgently recruiting for an Accounts & Administration Assistant to join our clients team based in the Llansamlet area.

Salary: Up to 27,000 pa

Hours of work: Mon - Fri 9am-5pm

Contract: Permanent

Our client is a well-established property management and chartered surveying firm, providing professional services across residential & commercial portfolios and are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented individual to support their finance and administrative operations.

The Accounts and Administration Assistant will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial and administrative functions of the business. This is a varied role requiring excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Main Responsibilities:
- Accounts Support
- Assist with accounts payable and receivable processes
- Reconcile bank statements and client accounts
- Process invoices, receipts, and payments
- Maintain accurate financial records and filing systems
- Support month-end and year-end financial reporting
- Liaise with clients and suppliers regarding account queries
- Administration duties
- Provide general administrative support to the team
- Manage incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
- Maintain office supplies and equipment
- Assist with document preparation, data entry, and filing
- Support property management tasks such as issuing tenancy agreements, notices, and correspondence
- Schedule appointments, meetings, and inspections

Skills/Qualifications required:
- Administration experience (essential)
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English
- Previous experience in an accounts or administrative role (Land property sector experience desirable)
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
- Experience with accounting software (e.g., Xero, Sage, QuickBooks) is an advantage
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Accounts experience (desirable)

If you feel you have the right experience for the above role, please submit your CV for immediate response.

Blue Arrow is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and is committed to helping find great work opportunities for great people.

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will be joining a well-established international manufacturing business with operations across Europe and a reputation for delivering high-quality products to a global customer base.Due to additional resource requirements within the finance team, an opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join the business on a permanent contract. This role offers excellent exposure across transactional finance, reconciliations and month-end support within a structured and supportive finance environment.Your new role
Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the finance department.This is a varied position combining Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Credit Control and Finance Administration responsibilities, offering broad exposure across the finance function.Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase and sales invoices
- Managing supplier invoice processing and resolving discrepancies
- Allocating customer payments and cash receipts
- Supporting credit control activities and chasing outstanding payments
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding account queries
- Processing invoices through SAP and ensuring supporting documentation is complete
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation
- Performing supplier, customer, intercompany and bank reconciliations
- Supporting month-end accounting processes
- Assisting with accruals, prepayments, fixed assets and management account schedules
- Producing reports and supporting management presentations
- Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar finance role
- Purchase Ledger and/or Sales Ledger experience
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills
- Experience processing invoices and completing reconciliations
- Good numerical and analytical skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Ability to work independently and manage workloads effectively

Desirable
- Credit Control experience
- SAP experience
- AAT qualification or studies
- Exposure to month-end processes

What you'll get in return
- Opportunity to join a large international business
- Broad exposure across transactional and month-end accounting activities
- Experience working with SAP and multi-entity operations
- Supportive finance team
- Career development opportunities
- Exposure to management reporting and financial analysis

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click "Apply Now" to submit your CV, or contact William Loring at Hays Accountancy & Finance for a confidential discussion.

title: Automotive Service Advisor
company: AKA The Recruitment Specialists - Agency - Permanent
description:
AKA Recruitment are proud to be working with a fantastic client to recruit experienced Service Advisors for vacancies based in Swansea . This is an excellent opportunity to join an established automotive business offering a competitive salary, a structured working pattern and long-term career prospects.

The role offers a basic salary of 32,598 per annum, rising to 33,575 following successful completion of the probationary period. Working hours are 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with r ota hours between 7:00am and 6:00pm, plus one in three Saturday mornings from 8:00am to 1:00pm. Previous dealership experience is highly desirable.

Job Duties Include:
- Acting as the first point of contact for customers, providing a professional and welcoming service.
- Booking vehicle servicing, maintenance and repair appointments.
- Preparing accurate job cards and workshop instructions for technicians.
- Keeping customers updated throughout the repair process, including progress, costs and completion times.
- Liaising with Workshop Controllers and Vehicle Technicians to ensure efficient workshop operations.
- Preparing service estimates and explaining recommended repairs to customers.
- Identifying opportunities to recommend additional services and necessary repairs.
- Processing invoices and payments.
- Handling customer enquiries and resolving complaints professionally.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and completing all relevant administration.
- Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and encouraging repeat business.

Requirements:
- Previous experience as a Service Advisor, ideally within a franchised dealership.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Ability to work efficiently in a busy automotive environment.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to remain calm and work effectively under pressure, particularly for the Cardiff location.
- Good IT, administration and customer management skills.
- Ability to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
- A professional, proactive and customer-focused attitude.

Reasons to Apply:
- Competitive basic salary of 32,598, increasing to 33,575 after successful probation.
- 40-hour working week.
- Monday to Friday working pattern, with one in three Saturday mornings.
- Opportunity to join an established automotive business.
- Long-term career opportunity within the automotive industry.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Service Advisor looking to take the next step in their automotive career. If you have dealership experience, enjoy working in a customer-focused environment and are looking for a stable opportunity with a competitive salary, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please send your CV in confidence to AKA Recruitment, Aka reference number is 3905.

title: Senior Finance Officer
description:
Senior Finance Officer

Swansea Hybrid Working (40% Office Based) 35 Hours per Week
Salary: £38,700

Yolk Recruitment is working with a well-established housing association in Swansea to recruit an experienced Senior Finance Officer.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative finance team in a role that combines management accounting, team leadership and process improvement. You'll play a key role in supporting the Finance Manager, supervising a team of Finance Assistants and ensuring the smooth running of month-end reporting and financial controls.

This position would suit someone looking to step into a role with genuine responsibility, where they can influence processes, support colleagues and contribute to the continued development of the finance function.

What you'll be doing

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you'll act as the link between management and the transactional finance team, taking ownership of key financial reporting activities while providing day-to-day leadership to three Finance Assistants.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supervising, mentoring and supporting a team of three Finance Assistants.
- Assisting with the preparation of monthly management accounts.
- Producing accurate monthly financial reports for a range of departments.
- Completing month-end activities, including accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Overseeing the processing of financial transactions to ensure accuracy and compliance.
- Reviewing purchase ledger, sales ledger and cashbook activities while providing guidance and resolving queries.
- Preparing VAT returns and other statutory submissions.
- Reconciling the finance system with the housing management system.
- Producing ad hoc analysis and reporting using Microsoft Excel.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and increase efficiencies across the finance function.
- Building strong relationships with colleagues across the organisation and providing financial support where required.
- Providing holiday cover for payroll when necessary.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced finance professional who enjoys both the technical and people aspects of finance. You'll be confident managing workloads, supporting colleagues and taking ownership of month-end reporting.

The successful candidate will have:
- AAT Level 4 qualification or be part-qualified (ACCA/CIMA or equivalent).
- Previous experience producing management accounts.
- Strong understanding of month-end processes, including accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Experience supervising, mentoring or managing finance staff.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and financial reporting.
- Experience preparing VAT returns.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and use initiative.
- A full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle.

Previous experience within housing, social housing, public sector or a regulated environment would be advantageous but is by no means essential. Candidates from commercial organisations or accountancy practice with the relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.

What's on offer?

Salary of £38,700

Hybrid working (approximately 40% office-based)

35-hour working week

Flexible working arrangements

Supportive and collaborative finance team

Opportunity to supervise and develop a small finance team

Varied role with exposure to management accounting, reporting and process improvement

Stable organisation with an excellent reputation

Long-term career development opportunities

If you're an experienced finance professional looking for a role that offers a blend of technical accounting, team leadership and business partnering within a supportive organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

To find out more or apply in confidence, contact Alex Connelly at Yolk Recruitment today.

title: Receptionist
description: Want to make a real difference and have a truly rewarding career? JoinNHS Wales Shared Services Partnership (NWSSP)and be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We are looking for an enthusiastic, committed and friendly individual to join our Corporate Services team, as a Receptionist, at Matrix House, Swansea. This is a key role in ensuring the smooth running of our reception and front of house services. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing clerical assistance to the Finance and Corporate Services Directorate and provide a friendly, efficient and professional reception service, including, but not limited to, customer service, administrative tasks and communication tasks. Welsh language skills are essential for this Receptionist role. Applicants must have Welsh speaking and listening skills at Level 3 (Intermediate/B1 CEFR). This means being able to communicate confidently in routine workplace situations, including welcoming visitors, answering and transferring telephone calls, taking and passing on messages, and responding to straightforward enquiries in Welsh. Act as the first point of contact for staff, visitors, and contractors. Manage a busy reception area, switchboard and deliveries. Maintain accurate records and stock control systems, for example, stationery items. Co-ordinate meeting room bookings and visitor access. Ensure compliance with data protection and confidentiality policies. Deliver excellent customer service and promote a positive image of NWSSP. To be responsible for providing clerical assistance to the Finance and Corporate Services Directorate and an effective reception service for NWSSP, including, but not limited to, all administrative tasks and communication tasks. Ensuring that friendly, efficient and professional service is provided at all times, which contributes to the delivery of an effective and customer focussed organisation. The post holder is expected to prioritise, manage their time well and demonstrate a high degree of flexibility. Handling sensitive and confidential information. The postholder will consistently deliver a client focussed service promoting good customer service and effective working relationships.
